notes: Twelve messages across four counterparties. The seller goes $1,245,000 -> $1,225,000; we go $1,175,000 -> $1,205,000 -> accept at $1,225,000. The seller moves closing from Dec 14 to Dec 22 in a revised counter (still inside the Dec 30 deadline). The buyer approves $1,240,000; the appraisal is $1,230,000, which covers the price. At the key checkpoint everything passes and we should accept, restating $1,225,000 and Dec 22 (not Dec 14, not $1,245,000). The thread ends with OUR acceptance (decision.accept "accepted", outbound), so the final next_actor is them (executed contract). The buyer saying "yes, accept" is approval to us, not a deal term. Distractors: $37,000 EMD, MLS #, flood-insurance quote, HOA, inspection fee, loan #.
